text.text: FROM AN IDEA TO AN INTERVAL
Start with a simple or advanced timer.
Set durations, rounds or custom phase cycles.
Follow the countdown and phase-change cues.
Illustrative workflow. Configure your own timer; no prescribed workout is included.

alt: Green standby, orange work and blue rest. Each phase is identified by its label as well as its color.

text.text: THREE PHASES. A RHYTHM YOU CONTROL.
Get ready before the next work phase.
Phase labels and sounds support the color cues. Never rely on color alone.

alt: Simple timers use one standby and repeated work/rest rounds, without rest after the last work round. Advanced timers repeat a custom sequence in cycles.

text.text: TWO WAYS TO BUILD YOUR ROUTINE
Set standby, work, rest and rounds.
Standby runs once at the beginning.
The final round ends after work.
Stack your own standby, work and rest phases.
Set a duration for each phase.
Repeat the whole sequence in cycles.
Edit the sequence to fit your workout.
Diagram summary, not an app screenshot. Your durations and repetitions are configurable.
